concept: Fifteen machines are still out there, silent. They are not lost: we know exactly where they are. Send them a signal and hear what they came to discover.

settings.title: Settings
settings.languageHint: Switching does not reload the page or erase your progress.
settings.reducedMotionDesc: No camera moves, no parallax, and full text from the start.
settings.instantSignalDesc: One click sends the signal without holding.
settings.hotkeysDesc: Arrows or J and K: next and previous moment · Space: send signal · M: index · S: sound · L: language · R: reading mode · Esc: close.
settings.pauseDesc: Freezes the 3D and the animations until you resume them.
settings.liteDesc: The 3D only redraws when needed. Great for modest devices and low batteries.
settings.legibleDesc: Headings and voices in Atkinson Hyperlegible.
settings.soundDesc: Nothing ever plays unless you turn it on.
settings.narrationDesc: Reads each moment aloud as you enter it, with the browser's synthetic voice.
settings.noVoice: Your browser has no voice for this language.
settings.mobileHint: If you hear nothing on a phone, check that it isn't on silent.
settings.proDesc: Shows the technical panels open in every chapter.
settings.classroomDesc: Larger text, sound off, chapter-by-chapter navigation and discussion questions.
settings.resetDesc: Erases the patches, signals and quizzes saved in this browser.
settings.resetConfirm: This erases your patches, signals and quizzes from this browser. Continue?
settings.memoryOnly: Your progress will not be saved when you close the page.
settings.dataLinks: Every number has a source. Calculated estimates say so.
settings.toAi: Read the Use of AI statement
